sources_read: .qc-cache/kittle-2026-10-09-r9/rules/WebDev Rubrics QC.xlsx :: 'Quality Checks'!A17:D17 and 'Internal Quality Checks'!A17:Z17 (row 16; no internal annotation or cell comment present)

.qc-cache/kittle-2026-10-09-r9/task/tests/scored/*/judge.toml, tests/scored/*/prompt.md, tests/gates/*/judge.toml, tests/gates/*/prompt.md, tests/app_context.md (for n-gram overlap and criterion-id search)
evidence: Agent image verified by actual build: `docker build` of frozen task/environment (image sha256:ecdf083b..., removed afterwards) then `ls -la /app` shows only .git and an empty .gitkeep; `git ls-files` = .gitkeep, single commit 'Initialize task workspace'; /instructions holds only conversations.md, integration.md, walls-and-retention.md; /assets holds only seed_data.json; no /tests or /solution; `find / -xdev` for server.js/app.js/*.db/solve.sh (excluding node_modules) returned nothing. environment/Dockerfile is byte-identical to the frozen template Dockerfile (both sha256 0a75419e...), copies only instructions/ and assets/; environment/ contains no dotfiles or other files. seed_data.json (byte-identical to solution/app/seed/seed_data.json, as intended by the brief's 'copy into /app') is raw input state only (accounts, matters, messages with at/hold/parent/versions, walls, read_up_to); it carries no derived outputs (no precomputed expiry/deletion flags, unread counts, mention lists, transcript text, schema or route list) - e.g. K-1 (2026-05-01, 7-day matter) is still present and must be expired by the agent. Instruction notes describe product behavior in user voice; the only API route named is the template-standard GET /api/health; no schema, file layout, starter code or UI markup. Mechanical overlap: 10-token n-gram search between the three notes + instruction.md and all tests/*/prompt.md, judge.toml and app_context.md found only the accounts table shared with app_context.md; at 8 tokens only three short requirement phrases ('a link that opens in a new tab', 'shows a short preview of the linked message', 'type in the message box the app suggests') - restatements of public requirements, not criterion text. No criterion id, JUDGE- sentinel, 'Fails if' or rubric wording appears in environment/ or instruction.md. Broken-app probe: an agent cannot pass by copying anything from the image because no app, skeleton or partial UI exists; conforming-alternative probe: nothing in the environment fixes routes/schema/markup, so an alternative architecture is not penalized by this row.
